implementation.storage: Migration 00007 adds historical projection intervals, resource candidates, a committed log and generation/authentication state. Business writes, projection changes and query log records commit in one transaction after the global commit-order lock. Migration 00008 and business API/worker/model registration were integrated for the business specialist
implementation.pagination: Database-side filters and resource candidates, sort_ms DESC/id ASC with SQLite BINARY and PostgreSQL C collation, snapshot-bound signed keyset tokens, current resource and execution authorization before return
implementation.rebuild: Current documents, hot/archive observations, rollups, revisions and gaps recreate the projection in one atomic generation switch; version precedence preserves the newest derived observation; cancellation or error preserves the previous generation
implementation.subscriptions: One per-service poller shares current windows only for matching canonical query and current identity/session/grant scope. Snapshot, coalesced committed-window delta, checkpoint and reset events use signed opaque cursor strings. Deletion/removal uses a newer commit revision. Reconnect reconstructs the prior window before comparing the current window
implementation.permissions: Database candidates require all row resources within currently authorized ancestry; final entity/observation checks and Control.Detail cover current and historical execution resources. User, session, delegation, grant/bundle and ancestry changes invalidate the bound query scope and clear obsolete cache

write_paths.direct_and_http: Entity and business application writes flow through Tx.Put, SetEphemeral and Delete hooks
write_paths.native_alarm: native_alarm_state updates reproject the linked alarm and expose independent native state
write_paths.cloud_receipts: Immutable command evidence inserts mark the execution projection even when its business status/version remains unchanged
write_paths.task_recovery: Execution and business task recovery uses the same domain writes; existing entire-control-package recovery regressions passed on v2
write_paths.revisions_and_retention: Observation inserts, revisions, rollups, raw retention, archive expiry and rebuild preserve query history and invalidate superseded or deleted current rows

implementation.precision: Projection payloads retain exact JSON numbers; tests preserve 9007199254740993 and 18446744073709551615 through query/rebuild paths. Decimal query revision strings and opaque cursor strings avoid JavaScript number conversion
